status: Exploratory follow-up on previously analyzed public cohorts; not independent external confirmation
hypothesis: Microbial features improve chronological-age prediction beyond study, body site and sex.
primary_comparison: Metadata-adjusted microbial residual model versus inner-selected metadata-only ridge/random forest
secondary_comparison: Combined model versus independently tuned microbial random forest
validation: Three repetitions of 5-fold outer participant holdout; 3 inner participant folds; preprocessing refitted inside inner training
primary_outcome: Participant-weighted MAE reduction averaged across all three repetitions
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap of participant-mean absolute errors, stratified by source study; conditional on recorded fitted predictions
reporting: Retain all repeats, all comparisons and all selected hyperparameters, including null/negative results. No blood-skin fusion accuracy claim.
